THE SPLIT PLATE / RECIPE

Viral Proteinized Burger in a Bun

Two fully cooked lean patties, melty cheese and queso inside baked crescent dough for the adult; one smaller patty with cheese above and below for the kid. One oven finish, two versions.

YIELD4 servings
TOTAL TIMEAbout 45 min, including a 20 min dough bake
COOK METHODOven
EST. / SERVING~700 cal | ~62g protein
KEY TO SUCCESS: Fully cook the ground-beef patties before wrapping. Check ground beef with a food thermometer; the dough bake is not a raw-beef cooking step.

Ingredients

SHARED BASE

  • Fully cooked ground-beef patties: four 4 oz raw-weight 93/7 patties for two adult burgers and two 3 oz raw-weight 80/20 patties for two kid burgers
  • Pillsbury Original Crescent Dough Sheet: two weighed 250-calorie portions for the adult burgers; enough to enclose two kid patties (kid dough not weighed)

Kid — smaller burger

  • 3 Velveeta Original cheese slices for two kid burgers (1.5 slices each: 3/4 under and 3/4 above each patty)
  • Onion optional; Tushar's kids had none

OPTIONAL ONION BATCH

  • 1 yellow onion + 1 tsp avocado oil + 1 tsp balsamic vinegar + 1 tsp monk-fruit sweetener + salt, cooked down; add to taste

Adult — double burger

  • 3 oz Velveeta Original Shreds (1.5 oz per adult burger)
  • 2 tbsp homemade high-protein chipotle-style queso (1 tbsp per adult burger)
  • Chopped chilies, optional
  • Caramelized onion, to taste, optional
  • 2 label servings (2.8 oz each) Jesse & Ben's Sweet Potato Tallow Fries, optional
  • Ketchup, optional (excluded from plate estimate)

Allergens: dairy, wheat, gluten.

After fully cooking the patties. Wrap a two-patty adult stack and a one-patty kid stack separately, then bake together.

Method

Shared base

  1. 1.COOK THE PATTIES FIRST. Shape two 4 oz 93/7 adult patties and one 3 oz 80/20 kid patty per kid burger, using raw weights. Fully cook and verify ground-beef doneness with a food thermometer before wrapping.
  2. 2.COOK THE OPTIONAL ONION. Soften one sliced yellow onion in 1 tsp avocado oil; add 1 tsp balsamic, 1 tsp monk-fruit sweetener and salt. Cook until browned. Use as much as you like; onion is outside the stated macros.
  3. 3.PREHEAT AND PORTION DOUGH. Heat oven to 375°F. Weigh a 250-calorie portion of crescent dough for the adult burger and portion enough additional dough to enclose each kid patty. The kid portions were not weighed in the filmed cook.

Adult — double burger

  1. 4.BUILD THE ADULT BURGER. Stir the 1.5 oz Velveeta shreds with 1 tbsp protein queso. Layer some cheese mixture, the two fully cooked patties, optional chilies and onion, and the remaining cheese mixture inside the weighed dough.
  2. 5.SEAL AND BAKE. Close all dough seams. Bake at 375°F for about 20 minutes, until the dough is fully baked and the filling hot. If serving fries, spread one 2.8 oz serving on parchment and bake per its package while the bun bakes. Cut open and serve.

Kid — smaller burger · Kid — smaller burger

  1. 4.BUILD THE KID BURGER. Lay 3/4 cheese slice on the kid dough, add one fully cooked 3 oz 80/20 patty, then top with the other 3/4 slice. Skip onion for Tushar's filmed version.
  2. 5.SEAL AND BAKE. Enclose the kid filling completely and bake alongside the adult burger at 375°F for about 20 minutes, until the dough is fully baked and the filling hot. Portion by appetite.

SPLIT PLATE SERVING

Adult — double burger: About 700 cal / 62g protein before onion; about 820 cal / 63g protein with one serving of fries, before onion or ketchup.

Kid — smaller burger: No kid nutrition number: the dough amount and served portion were not tracked.

Keys to success

  • Weigh the adult dough to your tracked 250-calorie portion. A guessed fraction of a can will not preserve the published estimate.
  • Seal every seam, then bake until the dough is fully baked and the filling hot. Treat 20 minutes as a guide, not a doneness test.

Estimated nutrition

~700 cal | ~62g protein.

Adult burger before onions: two raw-weight 4 oz 93/7 beef patties (340 cal / 48g protein) + a user-weighed 250-calorie Pillsbury crescent dough portion (~4g protein) + 1.5 oz Velveeta Original Shreds (~90 cal / 7.5g protein) + 1 tbsp high-protein chipotle-style queso (~20 cal / 2g protein) = about 700 cal / 62g protein. Add one 2.8 oz label serving of Jesse & Ben's sweet-potato fries (120 cal / 1g protein) for an adult plate of about 820 cal / 63g protein. Both estimates exclude variable onion; the plate estimate also excludes ketchup. Fat and carbohydrate totals were not verified from the exact labels and are intentionally unpublished. The kid patty is 3 oz 80/20 beef raw weight, but the dough amount was not weighed, so kid macros are not published.
